name: D's Cannon Blast
subtitle: Sink the cargo, win treasure
promotionalText: Fire the cannon, topple towers of cargo and send it all splashing into the sea! Storms, sharks, snow and whirlpools await on hundreds of levels.
description:
Take aim and BLAST! D's Cannon Blast is a fast, satisfying cannon game: hold to fire, knock towers of crates, barrels and buoys off their rafts and sink every piece of cargo before you run out of cannonballs.

EASY TO PLAY, HARD TO PUT DOWN
• Hold to fire rapid cannonballs and drag to aim
• Topple towers and watch the cargo crash into the sea
• Fill the bomb meter for a giant explosive shot
• Earn up to 3 stars by saving cannonballs

HUNDREDS OF LEVELS THAT KEEP GETTING HARDER
• Ice blocks that shatter, balloons that float away and iron crates that take two hits
• Powder kegs that set off explosive chain reactions
• Rafts that sway, circle and ride the waves
• Boss fortresses every 10 levels and HARD levels with bigger rewards

WILD OCEAN WEATHER
• Storms and snowstorms with wind that bends your shots
• Whirlpools that spin the rafts
• Leaping fish (hit one for a bonus shot!) and hungry sharks that snatch cannonballs

POWER UP
• Mega Blast, Slow-Mo and Laser Aim power-ups
• Unlock Fire Ball, Anchor Ball and Splitter cannonballs
• Paint your cannon with five cool colors

COME BACK EVERY DAY
• Daily rewards and a free Lucky Spin
• A new Daily Challenge each day with a Game Center leaderboard
• Goals and achievements with coin rewards

No ads. No sign-up. Plays offline. Just pure cannon-blasting fun!

review.notes: D's Cannon Blast is a single-player physics cannon game. No account or login is needed. Tap Play, then hold a finger on the screen to fire and drag to aim; sink all the cargo to clear a level. The Daily Challenge submits scores to a Game Center leaderboard if the player is signed in to Game Center. The app has no ads, no in-app purchases and collects no data; progress is stored only on the device.
